reason: E1 shows that nanoscale twinning in CoCrFeMnNi at cryogenic temperatures postpones necking and improves strength-ductility, supporting the twinning-ductility premise. However, neither E1 nor E2 provides evidence that Co removal lowers SFE or that FeNiCrMn exhibits more twinning than the Co-containing baseline; these core premises are unsupported by the cited passages.
premises: Co removal lowers stacking fault energy (SFE) in FeNiCrMn
